pages.title: Entity List
pages.text: Gets entities within a certain range, pushes as entity list onto stack.

Supports two usages:

• vec3 a, vec3 b -> Entity List -> List
Gets all entities within axis-aligned bounding box defined by two coordinates

• vec3 a, vec3 b, EntityType c -> Entity List -> List
Gets only entities of type c within axis-aligned bounding box defined by two coordinates
